... ... Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Sanjay Kumar Sinha, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Murlidhar, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Satyavrat Verma
 Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. Issue notice to the Opposite Party No. 2 by both modes i.e. registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary post for which requisites etc. must be filed on or before 27.09.2023 failing which the present quashing application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
3. Put up this case on 11.01.2024.
4.

In the meantime, the order dated 02.06.2016 passed by the learned A.C.J.M-III, Nawada in Mahila P.S. Case No. 19 of 2014 arising out of Complaint Case No. 813 of 2014 whereby cognizance has been taken under Section 498A of the Indian Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.7610 of 2017(2)
dt.19-09-2023 Penal Code, shall remain stayed as it has been submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the stage of the case from the stage of cognizance, till date, has not changed and the petitioner is disputing the marriage.

(Satyavrat Verma, J) Rishabh/-
